notes.title: Warfare Legacy Collection OUT NOW
notes.content:
[b]From Castles to Command Posts; Crushing Enemies has never felt this good![/b]

Before he was dropping boulders on royal architecture, [b]Con Artist[/b] was dropping soldiers into the trenches, 

That’s right — the artistic mastermind behind [i]Warfare Legacy Collection[/i] also helped bring the castles crumbling down in the beloved [i]Crush the Castle Legacy Collection[/i]. Whether you're commanding troops or launching trebuchets, you're witnessing peak Con-quest.

And now, for the first time ever, these two Flash-born legends have united under one glorious banner:

[b]The Con Artist Command & Castles Bundle – 10% OFF! [/b]
Two fully remastered classics. One gloriously destructive package.

[b]Here’s What You’re Getting:[/b]
[i]Warfare Legacy Collection[/i] – Includes [i]Warfare 1917[/i], [i]Warfare 1944[/i], and the all-new [b]Battle of the Bulge campaign[/b]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2745870/Warfare_Legacy_Collection/

[i]Crush the Castle Legacy Collection[/i] – Includes the OG classic, its sequels, and enough trebuchet ammo to make medieval engineers weep
Both feature art and visual flair touched by Con himself

Whether you prefer precision strikes or physics-based demolition, We have you covered — with explosions, pixel-perfect chaos, and a healthy dose of nostalgia.

Wage war or flatten castles here; Choose Wisely!

notes.title: Warfare Legacy Collection Coming April 28th
notes.content:
[b]CLASSIFIED TRANSMISSION – Need to Know Basis Only!
From: Warfare Legacy Collection HQ
To: All Commanders in the Field
Priority: ULTRA TOP SECRET (But please TELL everyone you know)
Date: March 24th, 2025
SUBJECT: Operation Battle of the Bulge & Deployment Date[/b]

Commanders,

We have intercepted critical intelligence, and it's time to brief you on the most pivotal operation in Warfare Legacy Collection history.

[b]Operation Codename: "Battle of the Bulge"[/b]

After months of reconnaissance, strategic planning, and coffee-fueled late nights at HQ, we are officially launching one of our most ambitious campaigns yet—[b]The Battle of the Bulge.[/b]

Your orders? Defend or disrupt. The battle takes place in the winter of 1944, where Allied forces, caught off guard by a sudden German offensive, must dig in and hold the line. Harsh weather, dwindling supplies, and enemy deception will test your leadership like never before. Will you be the hero that turns the tide of war, or will you crumble under the weight of the enemy’s final, desperate push?

Expect [b]new tactical challenges, intense battles and some of the fiercest winter warfare you’ve ever seen.[/b] The fate of the Western Front is in your hands.


Deployment Date Confirmed: [b]April 28th[/b]

Attention, troops! We are now cleared to reveal our official launch date—[b]April 28th![/b] That’s right, Warfare Legacy Collection will be storming onto Steam [b]just in time for the Steam Wargames Fest.[/b] Prepare your battle plans, ration your energy drinks, and get ready to engage in warfare like never before.

Your Next Steps:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2745870/Warfare_Legacy_Collection/

Signed,
Your Con-manding Officer ‘Chris Condon’ reporting directly from Warfare Legacy Collection HQ

notes.title: Warfare Legacy Collection Coming Soon!
notes.content:
From Con Artist Games, the artist of the Crush the Castle series, comes another classic collection of two of their most popular games, Warfare 1917 and Warfare 1944.

Packaged together for the first time, Warfare Legacy Collection brings back all the action with remastered visuals, additional voice acting, localization, and other surprises.

[b]Watch the Trailer Now![/b]
Check out the trailer on the game's Steam page for a sneak peek at the remastered games!

[b]Enlist.. We mean Wishlist.. Today![/b]
Make sure to add Warfare Legacy Collection to your wishlist to stay updated on news, announcements, and the official release date.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2745870/Warfare_Legacy_Collection/

[b]Demo Coming Soon![/b]
We’re excited to announce that a demo for Warfare Legacy Collection will be available next month during Steam Next Fest! This is your chance to dive into the game and experience the action firsthand before launch.

Stay tuned for more updates, and we can't wait to share Warfare Legacy Collection with you!  Thank you for all your support of Armor Games and Con Artist Games!

notes.title: Sonny Legacy Collection Now Available on Steam!
notes.content:
We’re excited to announce the release of the [i]Sonny Legacy Collection[/i] on Steam! This collection brings together the iconic Sonny 1 & Sonny 2 RPG series, featuring quality of life updates, achievements and all the nostalgic elements fans know and love.

http://store.steampowered.com/app/2757720/Sonny_Legacy_Collection/

notes.title: Crush the Castle Legacy Collection is out TODAY!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41783987/f46a09901f0a856cec04379439e0658a6e2b4c69.png[/img]

The day you’ve been waiting for is finally here. [b]Crush the Castle is BACK in all its upscaled glory.[/b] This game was such an important series from the Armor Games site, and it’s all thanks to the millions of you who played the original games for making this happen. Legacy Collection comes with Crush the Castle, Crush the Castle 2, and Crush the Castle Adventures, along with the Players Packs from the first two games. We hope you enjoy it as much now as you did over ten years ago! If you’re more of a mobile person, you can also play on iOS and Android.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1838970/Crush_the_Castle_Legacy_Collection/

[b]Also, if you’re looking to give another piece of Armor Games nostalgia a spin, you can get both this game and The Last Stand Legacy Collection at a 10% discount as part of one large Legacy Bundle![/b] The Last Stand Legacy Collection is a fully remastered collection of the first three Last Stand zombie survival games and is certainly a worthy addition to any Flash game enthusiast’s collection.

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/25388/The_Legacy_Bundle/

notes.title: Updated Launch Date: March 29th
notes.content:
Hey Crushers!

Armor Games Studios here with an update about Crush the Castle: Legacy Edition. As we move forward with migrating these titles to a new platform like Steam, we've made the decision to push the launch back to the end of the month to allow us to polish out some final rough corners that came up during testing.

We appreciate all the enthusiasm people have shown us for this release, and are so excited to be able to continue to preserve these classic games for a new generation and platform, and hope we can continue to do so with more titles in the future!
